DIV8.HEAD: § 9999.1 Purpose and scope.
DIV8.P: (a) Purpose. This part sets out example rules for test deposit accounts held at an example bank.
(b) Scope. This part applies to every example bank that offers test deposit accounts to consumers.

DIV8.HEAD: § 9999.2 Notice of unauthorized withdrawals.
DIV8.P: (a) Consumer notice. A consumer must notify the example bank of an unauthorized withdrawal within 60 days after the statement is sent.
(b) Liability limits. (1) If the consumer gives notice within 2 business days, the consumer's liability shall not exceed $50.
(2) If the consumer gives notice after 2 business days, the consumer's liability shall not exceed $500.
(i) This limit applies only to withdrawals made with a lost access card.
(ii) The example bank must explain the limit in its initial disclosure.
(c) Investigation. The example bank shall investigate a notice and report the result within 10 business days.

DIV8.HEAD: § 9999.3 Availability of deposited funds.
DIV8.P: (a) Cash deposits. Cash deposited in person shall be available for withdrawal not later than the business day after the banking day of deposit.
(b) Large deposits. The example bank may extend a hold on the amount of deposits exceeding $5,000 on any one banking day, and must send a hold notice explaining the reason.
(h) Records. The example bank shall keep records of holds for 2 years.
(i) Interest. Interest begins to accrue not later than the business day on which the bank receives credit for the funds.

DIV8.HEAD: § 9999.5 Privacy notices.
DIV8.P: (a) Initial notice. An example bank must give a consumer a clear privacy notice not later than when the customer relationship is established.
(b) Opt out. A consumer may opt out of sharing with nonaffiliated third parties by calling a toll-free number.
